content.Title: 2023 AHA/ACC/ACCP/ASPC/NLA/PCNA Chronic Coronary Disease Guideline
content.Focus: The document discusses various interventions and guidelines for managing chronic coronary disease, including cardiac rehabilitation and physical activities.

Highlights: Exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation programs improve outcomes in patients with coronary artery disease.
High-intensity interval training can be compared favorably with moderate-intensity continuous training for improving exercise capacity.
Telehealth interventions for cardiac rehabilitation show effectiveness similar to traditional methods.
Long-term benefits of high-intensity interval training in heart transplant recipients are discussed.
